summary.text: Randy Lemm is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate representing District 20 (Hillsboro), serving since 2019. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Education, where he is vice chair, and Agriculture and Veterans Affairs.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Lemm is a farmer and rancher with a BS in animal science from NDSU.
His biography lists membership in the ND Stockmen's Association, the ND Farm Bureau, the ND Hereford Association and Kiwanis, and service on the board of the Red River Human Services Foundation.
In the interim he serves on the Agriculture and Water Management Committee and the Budget Section.
His biography lists him as married to Julie, with three children and six grandchildren.
